sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Security Holographic Cold Foil Printing of Collectible Trading Cards

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (romano-Germanic legal tradition with French and Belgian doctrinal influence; unitary national legal system, no sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: BLEU (Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union) – People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 4 June 1984; amended by Protocol of 22 November 2005)
BLEU – People's Republic of China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 18 April 1985; amended by Protocols of 1996 and 2009)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended by the Law of 12 July 2013 on the Special Limited Partnership (SCSp), Articles 27 to 43 and 944-1 et seq.; Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS) and the RESA electronic compendium
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Partnership Agreement (Contrat de Société / Statuts) of the SCSp filed for RCS registration and published in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; the SCSp may be formed with zero or minimal capital; contributions may be in cash or in kind; no escrow account or capital certification block required by law; capital adequacy is governed solely by the partnership agreement and commercial reasonableness
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the General Partner of LU_SCSP, acting under the Partnership Agreement dated [DATE], adopts the following first resolutions: (1) SUBSCRIPTION: all partnership interests offered, including the initial contribution of the General Partner, are approved and recorded in the Capital Accounts Register without any minimum-capital requirement; (2) REGISTERED OFFICE: the registered office is fixed at [street address], Luxembourg, and the General Partner is authorized to notify the Luxembourg Business Registers and the competent administrative authorities; (3) MANAGER: [Name] is appointed manager (gérant) with sole signature authority and full power to open bank accounts and execute agreements; (4) FILING: the Manager is instructed to file this resolution and all constitutive documents with the RCS and to effect publication in RESA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft, Execute and Sign the SCSp Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (optional unless real property is contributed) and Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) e-Registration portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SCSp partnership agreement in English or French, containing the corporate name (including 'SCSp' or 'Société en Commandite Spéciale'), registered office address, duration, object (ISIC 3240 collectible trading card production with security holographic cold-foil printing), identity of the General Partner and limited partners, contribution terms, profit-sharing rules, and manager appointment powers. Execute the agreement by all partners; notarization is not mandatory unless real estate or regulated assets are contributed. Attach the AML/KYC identification files of all partners and of the General Partner's legal representatives.
required_dossiers: Draft partnership agreement (Contrat de Société)
Valid passport or national ID of all partners and managers
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, dated < 3 months)
AML/KYC questionnaire and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration
LEI registration application (if required by the transacting bank)
Certificate of good standing of the General Partner if a legal entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS registrar raises formal objections, amend the affected clauses and resubmit through the LBR helpdesk; complete missing KYC attachments and reload the corrected PDF dossier within 10 business days of the query notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation with the RCS via Luxembourg Business Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the registration application through the LBR e-Registration online platform. Upload the signed partnership agreement, the manager's acceptance, the registered office consent letter from the owner of the premises, and the approved corporate name reservation. Pay the official registration fee of approximately EUR 86 via the portal. Obtain the RCS registration number and request issuance of the certificate of registration.
required_dossiers: Executed partnership agreement (PDF)
Manager's signed acceptance of office
Consent letter of the registered office provider/landlord
Extract of criminal record (casier judiciaire) of the manager, issued within 3 months
Proof of payment of the registration fee
RCS application form (standard LBR template)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of rejection or query, reply with a corrective submission noting each objection, amend the partnership agreement or annexes, and refile; for urgent matters request expedited treatment from the LBR support service with payment of the priority fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, the registry automatically transmits the constitutive acts for publication in the RESA electronic compendium; verify the publication entry and confirm that the registered office, manager identity, and company object appear exactly as filed. The publication is a publicity requirement under the Law of 19 December 2002 and effective against third parties upon filing.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract
Published notice data sheet (entity name, form SCSp, registered office, manager, object, date of constitution)
Administrative authorization of the RCS for the RESA publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RESA publication contains errors, file a correction petition with the LBR and obtain a rectified publication; third-party reliance may be avoided by prompt filing of the pursuant rectification notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for the Business Establishment Permit (Autorisation d'Établissement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of the Economy - Direction de l'Autorisation d'Établissement (Department for Establishment Permits)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application through MyGuichet.lu using the establishment permit e-form. Declare the subject activity as ISIC 3240 (Manufacture of games and toys) and NAICS 323111 (Commercial Printing, security holographic cold-foil printing). Provide proof of the manager's professional competence (diploma or 3 years' relevant professional experience) and the applicant's good repute. Pay the permit fee (approximately EUR 350 for commercial industrial establishments).
required_dossiers: Official establishment permit application form (MyGuichet.lu)
Certificate of good conduct (casier judiciaire) for the manager and General Partner
Diploma or certificate of professional competence in printing or relevant manufacturing
RCS extract of LU_SCSP
Lease agreement or proof of title of the production premises
Scheduling of planned activities and description of production processes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry issues a request for additional information, submit the missing evidence within 3 months; refusal may be appealed to the Minister of the Economy within 30 days of notification, and subsequently to the administrative court (Tribunal Administratif).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register for VAT and Social Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA (AED); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the VAT registration declaration (form 1 / déclaration d'assujettissement) with the AED within 15 days of the first taxable transaction, communicating the RCS number and business address; obtain the Luxembourg VAT identification number. If the SCSp will employ staff, register as employer with the CCSS and submit the declaration for affiliation of the manager and employees to the social security scheme.
required_dossiers: VAT registration form (Formulaire 1)
RCS registration extract
Copy of the business establishment permit (autorisation d'établissement)
Employer registration form (CCSS) and identity documents of staff
Bank account details of the SCSp
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of delay or query, complete the missing annexes and resubmit; liaise directly with the AED taxpayer service for VAT issues and with the CCSS affiliation desk for social security registration; lateness penalties are waived where good-faith curing is documented.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open the Corporate Bank Account and File the Beneficial Ownership Register (RBE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE); licensed Luxembourg credit institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the formation dossier to a Luxembourg bank (or a foreign EU branch) with the RCS extract, partnership agreement, manager IDs, and business plan to open the operating account and effect payment of contributions. Thereafter file the beneficial ownership (RBE) declaration with the LBR within 1 month of registration, identifying the individuals ultimately owning or controlling the partnership, including the General Partner and any limited partner with >25% interest.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Notarized or certified partnership agreement
Business establishment permit
KYC/AML forms of the bank and proof of source of funds
RBE beneficial ownership filing form (LBR template)
Corporate bank account opening resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the opening due to KYC queries, supply supplementary source-of-funds documentation and a formal letter of explanation; if the RBE filing is flagged, correct the ownership percentages or control mapping and refile before the one-month deadline to avoid penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy - Direction de l'Autorisation d'Établissement (Department for Establishment Permits)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'Établissement (Business Establishment Permit) for Industrial Manufacture of Games and Toys and Commercial Printing, together with the Commune Exploitation Permit for Classified Establishments (permis d'exploitation pour établissements classés)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Registration with a Simplified Environmental Statement under the Law of 29 August 2017 on Classified Establishments, applicable to cold-foil holographic printing lines with solvent consumption below the IED thresholds of 150 kg/hour or 200 tonnes/year; a Full EIA (Category 1) would be triggered only upon expansion beyond those thresholds or addition of chemical coating processes exceeding the defined Annex II capacities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: VOC emission limit of 50 mg C/Nm³ in waste gas after abatement per Directive 2010/75/EU and the Grand-Ducal Regulation on VOC-emitting processes; wastewater discharge to public sewer must meet municipal limit values (COD ≤ 1000 mg/L, suspended solids ≤ 500 mg/L, pH 6.5-9.5) under the communal wastewater regulation; waste management obligations for solvent-contaminated rags, ink cartridges, and holographic foil offcuts in accordance with the Law of 21 March 2012 on waste; binding noise limit of 65 dB(A) daytime and 45 dB(A) night at property boundaries.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (avis de sécurité) from the Administration des Services de Secours (CGDIS) covering the cold-foil printing, ink storage, and solvent storage areas, including temporary fire-escape certification; structural load inspection of the production floor certified by a Luxembourg-approved engineering office under EU 1/2018 (Eurocode); occupational health clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) confirming compliance with the Law of 17 June 1994 on workplace safety, including chemical risk assessment, ventilation adequacy, personal protective equipment provision, and the registration of workers through the joint health and safety structure.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) for direct tax; Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; official digital portal: guichet.lu/myguichet.lu, tax filing through pfi.guichet.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An SCSp is first registered with the Luxembourg Business Registers obtaining an RCS/matricule national identification number; for VAT, a non-established or EU supplier must file the Luxembourg VAT registration with AEDT via guichet.lu before making taxable supplies, submitting charter/By-Laws, registration certificate from home state, BO documentation, activity/estimated turnover, and appointing a fiscal representative when established outside the EU; VAT ID is assigned as LU + 8 digits and the entity is treated as a separate taxable person for VAT even though income-tax-transparent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible - fiscally transparent for income tax purposes; partners are subject to tax in their respective jurisdictions; autonomous taxable person for VAT on supplies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box is available; SCSp is statutorily pass-through. Available elections include: VAT grouping (assujetti unique), small-enterprise VAT exemption waiver, optional advance tax ruling confirming transparency/classification, and elections under local tax law affecting withholding/real-estate transactions; ATAD hybrid-mismatch rules constrain transactions that exploit double non-taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée - Luxembourg EU VAT system)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover (exclusive of VAT) for established small enterprises; non-established suppliers have no threshold once any taxable supply occurs in Luxembourg, subject to EU distance-selling/OSS thresholds and reverse-charge rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime is in force. Mandatory e-invoicing applies only for B2G/public-procurement invoices (Peppol/EN 16931); B2B e-invoicing is optional; all invoices must satisfy EU invoicing rules and VAT records must be retained for a statutory period.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies where tangible collectible trading cards are sold by a Luxembourg taxable person and dispatched or transported to a destination outside the EU; the supply must be evidenced by a customs export declaration naming the supplier/exporter, and the complete chain of commercial, transport and payment evidence must show removal from the EU; directly connected transport, ancillary and offshore processing services may also qualify if separately supplied and documented.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD/electronic export declaration accepted by EU/Luxembourg Customs)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing EU port/airport of departure
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment evidence (SWIFT/MT103) proving export receivable
Commercial invoice, packing list and export contract
Transport documents (e.g., CMR consignment note) or courier's proof of delivery to non-EU address
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Luxembourg tax authorities may retrospectively disallow zero-rating and reassess VAT, with default interest, where export evidence is defective or payment is not received within prescribed periods. Deliberate falsification of export documents exposes the taxpayer to administrative fines, criminal sanctions (fines and/or imprisonment) for fraud, extended limitation periods, and possible joint liability of directors/representatives; VAT credits claimed on exports are subject to pre-refund audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) in coordination with the European Central Bank (ECB); prudential banking supervision is delegated to the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg is a founding member of the Eurosystem; the Euro is fully convertible on both current and capital accounts pursuant to Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. There are no exchange control approvals, no central bank licensing for capital movements, and no deposit or repatriation requirements for inbound or outbound flows. Profit and dividend remittance from a Luxembourg SCSp is unrestricted; because the SCSp is fiscally transparent for Luxembourg corporate income tax purposes, no Luxembourg withholding tax is levied on distributions to non-resident partners, provided substance, partnership deed, and transfer pricing documentation substantiate the distribution. Permanent establishment or taxable presence in other jurisdictions is the only material constraint.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender or mandatory FX conversion rules apply in Luxembourg or anywhere in the Eurosystem. The printing and exporting entity is free to hold export proceeds in EUR or in any foreign currency in licensed Luxembourg bank accounts without conversion, repatriation, or declaration obligations beyond standard BCL balance-of-payments statistical reporting by the bank. For ISIC 3240 exports, EU customs export declarations (SAD/EXA and exit summary declarations) are required, but these are customs formalities and do not impose FX surrender.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account + Operational Treasury Current Account (multi-currency EUR/USD/GBP)
Operational EUR/USD Current Account with SEPA and SWIFT settlement facilities
Foreign Currency Settlement and FX Hedging Account with documentary credit facilities

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkees)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EUR Account with TARGET2 large-value clearing access and custody line
Private/Institutional Escrow and Investment-Class Account for sponsor capital

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-to-Low as a primary treasury rail. A CSSF-licensed payment institution or e-money institution under PSD2 may open payment accounts, execute SEPA/SWIFT payments, and provide card acquiring settlement for Stripe/Authorize.Net flows, but EMIs are not full credit institutions: they cannot grant credit, do not hold deposit-guarantee coverage, and must safeguard client funds in segregated accounts. Luxembourg EMIs and passporting EU EMIs frequently apply stricter risk appetite to SPV/SCSp structures and collectible goods trading; therefore an EMI is viable only as a non-exclusive collection/disbursement rail with capped balances, while all capital escrow, FX, and settlement liquidity must sit with a Tier-1 credit institution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under the Luxembourg AML/CFT Law of 12 November 2004, as amended, and CSSF regulations, every authorised signatory and every Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) must be identified and verified before account activation. In practice, Tier-1 Luxembourg banks require a physical or high-definition interactive video interview with at least one corporate representative of the SCSp and its general partner, supported by notarially authenticated partnership deed, register of beneficial owners (RBE) excerpt, valid passports, and apostilled/official translations of non-EU corporate documents. Fully remote opening without any physical representative is generally rejected for corporate credit-institution accounts; remote opening is possible only for low-velocity EMI accounts and requires eIDAS-qualified electronic identification plus enhanced due diligence for non-EU directors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Layered SCSp partnership with undisclosed limited partners; the bank cannot identify underlying natural-person UBOs above or below the 25% threshold.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full partnership deed (acte constitutif and status), up-to-date extract from the Luxembourg Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE), organisational chart tracing every natural-person UBO, signed UBO attestation on the CSSF standard template, and a statutory declaration by the general partner confirming no bearer shares, no nominee partners, and no undisclosed trusts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient economic substance: SCSp is a mailbox vehicle with no local office, no local management, and no real operational activity, triggering CSSF and bank anti-shell red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance bundle comprising a registered-office lease in Luxembourg, the general-partner mandate and local management agreements, employment or consultancy contracts for local directors, minutes of management meetings held physically in Luxembourg, a business plan evidencing actual ISIC 3240 foil/holographic printing operations, and forecast staff and capital expenditure in Luxembourg.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection originating from a high-risk third country, a FATF-listed jurisdiction, or a partner with unexplained wealth, causing sanctions/PEP/name-screening alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements for each contributing partner, twelve months of bank statements from the remitting institution, tax residence certificates, underlying commercial contracts evidencing the capital contribution or equity bridge loan, EU/OFAC/UN sanctions screening reports for all parties and beneficial owners, and, where applicable, a Wolfsberg-style correspondent-bank reference or certificate of non-confiscation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Activity mismatch: the banking profile describes manufacturing/printing while transaction patterns indicate high-velocity collectible-card e-commerce or marketplace aggregation, triggering AML velocity and consumer-protection alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised business plan covering ISIC 3240 trading-card manufacture, signed distributor and retail agreements, commercial invoices and purchase orders, EU customs export declarations evidencing physical goods flow, and structured Stripe/Authorize.Net settlement statements showing a stable, low-ticket consumer basket of card sales rather than opaque peer-to-peer or money-service-business transactions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: No BCL or ministry authorisation is required for inbound capital into a Luxembourg SCSp. The compliant routing is: (i) the contributing partner executes a capital call/injection notice under the partnership deed; (ii) the remitter sends a SWIFT MT103 in EUR (or USD via a correspondent EUR leg) to the Luxembourg IBAN, with field 70 stating 'SCSp capital contribution – [deed reference]' and using the bank's standard purpose code for capital payments (e.g., CAPA/INVS); (iii) the receiving bank performs sanctions screening on the remitter and UBO before provisional credit; (iv) the full KYC/UBO file and source-of-funds evidence are delivered to the compliance desk; (v) after final booking, the SCSp issues a capital contribution receipt, updates the RBE register if any partner holding changes, and records the contribution in the annual accounts. For non-EUR injections, the receiving bank may offer an uncontracted FX conversion into EUR at the prevailing mid-rate; this is optional and does not alter the capital-contribution status.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements to foil, holographic-material, and printing suppliers: (i) EUR payments inside the EEA use SEPA Credit Transfer (ISO 20022 pain.001) with clearing via TARGET2 and next-day settlement; (ii) non-EEA payments use SWIFT MT103 wires with invoice/PO references in field 70 and correspondent-bank settlement in the beneficiary currency; (iii) large or risky documentary purchases use a commercial Letter of Credit confirmed through a Luxembourg Tier-1 bank, transmitted by SWIFT MT700/MT710, and supplemented by SWIFT MT760 standby guarantees where advance payment is required; (iv) e-commerce collections from Stripe and Authorize.Net are settled to the treasury account via SEPA or SWIFT in periodic payouts, after card acquirer netting; (v) the blueprint segregates partner capital in an escrow sub-account, trade cashflow in an operational account, and FX conversion in a dedicated settlement account to produce a clean audit trail for BCL statistical reporting and annual audit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD FX Forwards (plain vanilla, bilateral under ISDA/CSA with a Tier-1 Luxembourg or EU credit institution)
EUR/GBP FX Forwards for UK distributor and licensee settlements
FX Swaps (spot-next and tom-next rollovers on revenue conversion accounts to manage settlement timing)
Cross-Currency Swaps for long-dated USD receivables, provided EMIR clearing thresholds are not exceeded and collateral arrangements are documented

NDFs for non-convertible or restricted supplier/distributor currencies (e.g., select Asian and Latin American currencies), executed offshore through an institution authorised to offer NDFs to EU corporates and subject to EMIR margining and reporting

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RCS Annual Data Confirmation (Confirmation annuelle des données RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days after the RCS registration anniversary (electronic eConfirmation portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: RCS sends reminder and refers the matter to the competent commercial court; court may impose coercive fines and order compliance; persistent default leads to judicial deletion (strike-off) of the RCS registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO / RBE Annual Confirmation (Confirmation annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each RCS registration anniversary; any change in beneficial ownership must be filed within 1 month of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fines of EUR 200 to EUR 5,000 per violation; daily coercive fines for continuing default; publication of non-compliance; risk of court-ordered strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts and RESA Publication (Dépôt des comptes annuels et publication au RESA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) with publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the balance-sheet date (e.g., by 31 July for a 31 December financial year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Referral to the Public Prosecutor; court order with coercive fine; administrative penalty up to EUR 10,000; two consecutive years of non-filing may trigger court-ordered dissolution and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Informational Partnership Tax Return Attributing Income to Partners (Déclaration fiscale de transparence de la SCSp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD / Luxembourg direct tax authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 December of the year following the tax year for e-filed returns (ordinary annual deadline with automatic e-filing extension)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty up to 10% of assessed tax (LIR Art. 280); coercive fines of EUR 100-500; default assessment by the ACD; partners' income attribution remains enforceable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Business Tax Return (Déclaration ICC) for Luxembourg Business Activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) on behalf of the competent Luxembourg commune
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 December of the year following the tax year for e-filed returns (calendar-year basis; automatic e-filing extension)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge up to 10% of ICC due; coercive fines; forced assessment and enforced collection against the SCSp's commercial assets.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit by an approved réviseur d'entreprises agréé when the SCSp exceeds at least two of the three EU thresholds for two consecutive financial years: balance sheet total EUR 4.4M; net turnover EUR 8.8M; average headcount 50. Audit is also required if the partnership agreement so provides, if the SCSp issues debt securities to the public, or if consolidation rules require it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP in accordance with the Code de commerce (Book 1, Title X) and the Law of 19 December 2020 on the accounting obligations of SCSp, transposing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; IFRS is not available for solo statutory accounts of a Luxembourg SCSp.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the UBO Law of 13 January 2019, the general partner (associé commandité) must confirm the SCSp's beneficial ownership data with the RBE within 30 days after each RCS registration anniversary. Any transfer of partnership interests requires an RBE amendment filed within 1 month of the transfer, accompanied by an updated partner schedule; the annual confirmation operates independently of such event-driven filings.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Partnership Interests and Transfers
Register of Managers and General Partner Resolutions (Minute Book)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,100-3,300 (EUR 1,000-3,000) per year for professional RCS domiciliation and registered-office services in Luxembourg
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for small SCSp exempt from mandatory audit; USD 9,000-30,000 (EUR 8,500-28,000) for a mandatory statutory audit once the size thresholds are exceeded
